## How was it tested?

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] `cargo test` passes (if Rust changed)

## For new or changed scenes

- [ ] Screenshot or short recording at day, night and in rain (use the simulator)
- [ ] Every selector is scoped with `[data-scene="..."]` and every `@keyframes` is prefixed
- [ ] Only `transform` and `opacity` are animated, and nothing runs continuously under reduced motion
- [ ] All assets are my own work or under a compatible license, credited in the manifest or `CREDITS.md`
